read_avro_from_file: read an Apache Avro file from a file path and return a Polars DataFrame
read_avro_with_columns: read an Apache Avro file and select specific columns by name or index
read_avro_with_n_rows: read an Apache Avro file and limit the result to the first n_rows
read_avro_from_file_object: read an Apache Avro file from a file-like object or BytesIO stream
read_avro_normalize_path: read an Apache Avro file using a Path object with normalized filepath
